name: MIL-STD-883 Method 1010.8 temperature cycling, test condition C (-65 C to +150 C, at least 10 cycles, at least 10 min dwell)
plain_name: Check that sealed military-grade chips survive repeated swings between -65 C and +150 C
description: Microcircuit screening/qualification by air-to-air temperature cycling per MIL-STD-883 Method 1010.8: a minimum of 10 uninterrupted cycles of test condition C, cold step -65 C (+0/-10) and hot step +150 C (+15/-0), dwell at least 10 min, load reaching temperature within 15 min (16 min for a single chamber), followed by visual examination and end-point electrical tests.
keywords: Check that sealed military-grade chips survive repeated swings between -65 C and +150 C

sources.citation: MIL-STD-883G Test Method 1010.8, Temperature Cycling (18 June 2004)

requirements.rationale: Condition C cold step is -65 C (+0/-10), so the working zone must reach -65 C = 208.15 K or colder (third column of the cold row; columns are conditions A-F).
Condition C hot step is +150 C (+15/-0), so the chamber must reach +150 C = 423.15 K or hotter (third column of the hot row).

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
